annotations.title: Check a VAT number against EU VIES

description: Check a Romanian VAT number against the EU's VIES register in real time: is it a valid VAT number today, under which name and address, and does that name agree with the company registry. Use it before invoicing a new supplier or when a buyer asks whether the VAT number on file is still live.

cui.description: Romanian tax identification number (CUI), e.g. '2816464'; 'RO' and leading zeros are accepted.
cui.title: Cui

name: check_vat

outputSchema.description: Live VIES validity plus a registry name cross-check.

cached.description: True when answered from the short-lived cache.

checked.description: False when VIES could not be reached.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

name.description: The name the EU holds for this number.

nameMismatch.description: True when the two names clearly disagree.

reason.description: Why the check did not run.

registryName.description: The name in the ONRC registry.

valid.description: True when VIES says the number is a live VAT number.

vatNumber.description: The number as queried, e.g. RO14399840.

title: Check a VAT number against EU VIES
